Update elite_robots_simulation_gz from 1.0.0-1 to 1.0.1-1.

Remove the unnecessary CMake find_package(rclpy REQUIRED) call to fix
configuration failures in ROS build farm builds. Keep rclpy as a runtime dependency.

Bloom successfully pushed the release branches and tags, but automatic
PR creation failed with HTTP 401. This PR completes the rosdistro update.
